Dear colleagues,

We are recruiting a PhD researcher (fully funded 3-year position) in the Human-Centred Computing Section, University of Copenhagen, working on designing self-tracking technologies for chronic conditions. 

Application deadline: 29th November 2026
Earliest start date: 1 March 2027

The PhD project will investigate the relationship between bodies, technology and chronic illness, with a particular focus on self-tracking technologies. The project will explore how people with chronic conditions engage with these technologies and how technologies shape interactions with informal caregivers and health professionals. The project will critically examine how these technologies intersect with broader social, cultural and political norms around chronic illness. Research methods will include research through design and co-design. 

The PhD project is led by Assistant Professor Sarah Homewood and Associate Professor Tariq Andersen.
